gen-gf-unica-one-gf-prompt: Prompt reads large for its size, with small letters that look oversized and apertures you can see into. Unica One, meanwhile, brings the stencil-cut, commanding punch, while Prompt handles the quiet job of being read.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-saira: Blunt, uniform strokes up top, with generous daylight in every curve. Saira then runs rounded letters that stretch toward the top line, each s showing a see-through gap, so paragraphs read clean and quick.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aram: Futuristic from the first glance, Audiowide sets its letters like tiles. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic follows with a pincer-open c and a short step to capitals, softening the tiled look.
gen-almendra-display-fs-quicksand: Almendra Display has letters that never pinch shut, with a pronounced x-height giving every word an ornate, literary lift. Quicksand adds a wire-like, rounded lightness; that softness is what holds them together.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads bulky and sturdy, with a marker-like line weight and visible gaps in its letters. Grandstander supplies the bold, expressive punch, and that is the standout here.
gen-gf-offside-gf-tiktok-sans: Widely tracked, level and commanding, with curves that refuse to close. TikTok Sans adds a spacious c and an x-height nearly touching cap height, the modern edge of the pair.
gen-gf-unkempt-archivo: Blunt and expressive, Unkempt matches its t crossbar to the stem and keeps c distinct from o. Archivo sits beside it, curves opening outward, with a commanding x-height that steadies the page.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-asap: Asap reads smooth, its c forms open arcs and its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Asap beside flat, contrast-free Unkempt feels like a level voice next to a loud one.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-fira-sans: Unkempt gives its t a crossbar and stem of matching weight, and keeps c from closing into an o. But Fira Sans does the quiet work, with s curves open at both ends and a larger x-height.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans stands tall, its lowercase making words look sturdy and its e opening clearly to the right. Merriweather Sans under Unkempt gives expressive, commanding letters a sturdier footing.
